title: Dynamic Equilibrium
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Reversible process/equilibrium model investigation using dynamic equilibrium models and forward/reverse rate graphs. No chemical system manipulation is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for pH, rate factors, catalysts, equilibrium, and real-world claims
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation page opens, launch the reversible-reaction activity on that exact page. Use the model that shows forward and reverse reaction changes over time. Observe the system before and after it reaches a steady pattern. Record forward evidence, reverse evidence, what stays constant at equilibrium, and what is still changing microscopically.
